messages:
Maya K: quick heads-up — we have a Senior Infra Eng candidate scheduled for Wed 9am UTC (candidate is in IST). can we confirm panel availability and debrief owner? also need rubric clarification: how should we weight system design vs coding vs signals for this role?
Samir P: I can cover Wed 9am UTC. if anyone needs to swap, ping me. happy to take debrief if no volunteers. :thumbsup:
Jordan R: I can do the debrief instead of Samir if that helps — prefer to own notes for continuity. what's the current rubric breakdown?
Maya K: thanks Jordan — current draft from hiring team is: design 40, coding 35, communication/signals 25. but hiring manager asked if coding should be 40 for infra heavy role. looking for quick consensus.
Alexa C: I'm on the panel but prefer higher design weight for infra infra-architecture decisions. +1 to keeping design >= coding.
Eva R: small ask — candidate requested a quiet room and no recording. can we disable recording and confirm Zoom link shared only with panelists? also timezone: candidate will be joining at 2:30pm IST (which is 9am UTC).
Samir P: noted re: recording. Zoom host needs to disable recording and waiting room on. @maya_k can you set link to panel-only and add contingency phone-in?
Maya K: yes will do. I'll create the meeting with recording off and waiting room enabled, add calendar invite for panelists only, and include phone dial-in fallback.
Jordan R: rubric anchors — can we add short descriptors for 4/5/6 scores? e.g., design 5 = clear system trade-offs + scalability plan, coding 5 = production-ready solution + tests, signals 5 = telemetry plan and rollback considerations. saves time in debrief.
Alexa C: strongly agree on anchors. can we attach an abbreviated anchor doc to the calendar invite for reviewers? one page only.
Maya K: I'll draft a 1-pager anchor doc and drop it in the invite. @Interview Bot — please post the final invite link here when ready.
Interview Bot: Meeting created: Zoom link set (recording disabled), calendar invite sent to panelists. Link: https://zoom.redwood.example/j/987654321 — PIN and dial-in included.
Eva R: thx. quick note on scoring: if someone needs to swap at last minute, please mark whether you can still score the candidate or if you should be excused — we prefer to keep at least 3 scorers.
Samir P: If Jordan is debrief owner I can still score, but will hand notes to Jordan explicitly.
Jordan R: sounds good. I'll own debrief and consolidate scores into the hiring doc after the session.
Maya K: perfect — final checklist: 1) invite + zoom (done), 2) 1-pg rubric anchors (I'll update by EOD), 3) debrief owner Jordan, 4) disable recording (done). anything else?
Alexa C: please attach candidate resume and sample take-home notes (if any) to the invite.
Maya K: will attach resume now. thanks everyone! :heart:
Interview Bot: Reminder scheduled: 30 minutes before panel "Panel prep — review rubric anchors and resume" (sent to panelists).
